title: Chatbots built an "echo chamber of one" and now psychiatry has to decide if "AI psychosis" exists
summary: Researchers at King's College London and other institutions are examining whether "AI-associated psychosis" should become a clinical diagnosis. By OpenAI's own self-reported numbers, about 560,000 users show signs of psychosis or mania each week. Sycophantic chatbots can create an "echo chamber of one" that reinforces delusions.
